ValidationRule.description: Span Type is required. Partial (Hours) needs duration picklist or numeric. Full Day uses Start/End dates to derive duration.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Span_Type__c)), AND( ISPICKVAL(Span_Type__c, "Hours"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Span_Duration_Select__c)), ISBLANK(Span_Duration__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select Span Type and Span Duration (1–8) for Partial (Hours).
